Sample.evidence_source: [page/2/Text/14] Eight out of 10 invited patients participated in the study.

Country.evidence_source: [page/2/Text/14] Respondent recruitment was done in an inpatient psychiatric ward (UPC KULeuven, Belgium)

Population.evidence_source: [page/2/Text/14] The multidisciplinary team of the ward assessed those older inpatients with a recent history of a SA who were able to reflect upon and provide rich information on the process toward the SA.

Type.evidence_source: [page/2/Text/15] The researcher (Anke Bonnewyn), a member of the multidisciplinary team, invited respondents, explained the voluntary nature of participation, obtained informed consent, guaranteed confidentiality, and conducted interviews within 30 days following the SA.
